title: myroxylon dussii
intro: Myroxylon dussii, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Palo Santo include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as limonene, beta-pinene, and sesquiterpenes. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and support the immune system.
